title: Retry current-build dependency artifact download up to 3 times
summary: The Download Project Dependencies action now retries failed artifact downloads up to 3 times with 30-second delays between attempts to handle transient network errors from GitHub's Actions Results service.
key_points: Failed downloads trigger automatic retries instead of immediate failure
3 sequential attempts with 30-second waits between failures
Only the final attempt can fail the job; earlier attempts continue on error
Addresses intermittent ETIMEDOUT errors in the dependency download step
Happy path adds no time overhead since successful downloads skip remaining attempts
